# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report a vulnerability privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting.
Open the [new advisory form](https://github.com/freethinkingit/inline-email/security/advisories/new), or open the repository's **Security** tab and select **Report a vulnerability**.
Never report a vulnerability in a public issue.

Include the version you used, the input that triggers the problem, and what happens.

## Supported versions

The latest 4.x release is the supported version.
Fixes ship as a new 4.x release, not as a patch to an older one.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 4.x (latest) | Yes |
| < 4.0 | No |

## What happens next

You get a first response within 7 days.
We confirm the problem, work on a fix, and keep you updated in the advisory.
We disclose the vulnerability after a fix ships.
The advisory is published with the release that fixes it, and credits you unless you ask otherwise.
